confirmedFindings.title: DNS rebinding race condition enables SSRF against internal network
confirmedFindings.body: Checking hostname IP with dns.lookup before making a fetch to the raw URL allows DNS rebinding attacks on subsequent HTTP request connection.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Pin and connect directly to the validated IP address with custom http.Agent and specify Host header explicitly.
